title: Live Summary Updates
description: A summary that only shows up at the last step isn't much of a summary. Confirm the Booking Summary sidebar updates immediately after each step, not just once you reach Confirm.
successCondition: After completing the Origin & Destination step and clicking Next, the sidebar's Origin and Destination fields immediately show the selected labels while still on the Package Details step (before Pricing or Confirm are reached); after completing Package Details, the sidebar's Package field immediately shows the weight/dimensions summary while still on the Pricing step.
hints: Check the sidebar's content right after each Next click, before advancing further — don't wait until Confirm to look.
The Package summary format is "<weight>kg · <length>×<width>×<height>cm" — match the exact separator characters if your assertion is text-based.
